output.notes: Described the headline Falcon-180B (abstract/title model); all three configs listed. Falcon-40B/180B use two separate layer norms (attention and MLP branches) in a parallel block; Falcon-7B instead uses a single shared layer norm ('For Falcon-7B (later trained), we switched to a single layer norm.'), so block_ops match 40B/180B, not 7B. MLP width d_ff, layer-norm eps, RoPE theta/pairing, GeLU approximation, attention scale, and a final layer norm before the head are not stated (final norm omitted from head for that reason). Projection output widths for q/k/v follow from n_q, n_kv and d_head=64 but are left not_stated since not written as numbers. Pre-norm placement is inferred from the statement that each layer norm's affine can be folded into the subsequent linear layer. MoE left not_stated (only mentioned as future work). Architecture 'based on PaLM' but no values taken as inherited because the paper deviates (no SwiGLU, multigroup, etc.).
